newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Command Petroleum says in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Command Petroleum says in merger talks.

text.p: Command Petroleum Holdings NL said on Wednesday it had requested a suspension of trading in its shares as it was currently in negotiations with a party which may lead to a merger.
"The company is presently in the course of negotiations with a party which may lead to a merger between the company and such party," Command said in a letter to the stock Exchange.

"In view of the increase in the trading price and volume of the company's securities traded over the last two days, the company believes it is in the interests of its shareholders for further trading in the Company's securities to be suspended while these negotiations continue," it said. "While it is difficult to form a final view on timings, we do not consider it likely that negotiations will be finalised, one way or the other, until sometime during the course of next week."
Command Petroleum is the operator of India's Ravva offshore oilfield and has a 22.5 percent stake in the field.
It said last month it had upgraded Ravva's reserves by 22 percent to 189.3 barrels of oil equivalent.
Snyder Oil Corp owns 32.64 percent of Command.
Command's shares closed up eight cents at a year high of 97 cents on Tuesday.
